#Module dnd

HTML drag and drop for JavaScript (src/page/dnd.odin; native/js/runtime/web_dnd.c): the drag data store behind a DataTransfer (its items, its mode, dropEffect and effectAllowed, the drag image), the files a page was given (by a drop, an <input type=file>) as browser objects read on demand, and HTMLInputElement.files. The store's mode follows the event being dispatched (HTML "drag data store mode"): read/write in dragstart, read-only in drop, protected otherwise (types and kinds are visible, data and files are not).

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/js_dnd.widl.

Odin: import "wren:dnd".
